description: Vorranggebiet für Wasserversorgung is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. In priority areas, spatially significant uses are excluded, insofar as they are not associated with the priority use (here: The water supply is compatible. Regional plans define sensitive areas of groundwater catchment areas outside water protection areas as priority areas for water supply for public water supply by regional planning associations. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Priority area for water supply" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Wasser, HVD, Regionalplan, Versorgung, Trinkwasser, Vorranggebiet. The listing shows 2015-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
